definitions.explanation: A person who supports, encourages, or cheers for someone or something.

examples.japanese: {応援者|おうえんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A large number of supporters gathered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{応援者|おうえんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支|ささ}えられている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: He is supported by many backers.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{沿道|えんどう}→沿道：13270_endou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧な{応援者|おうえんしゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っていた→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Along the marathon route, enthusiastic supporters were sending cheers.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧ (support/cheering) and the suffix ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). This word covers both informal supporters and organized cheerleaders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧な{応援者|おうえんしゃ}: enthusiastic supporter
- {応援者|おうえんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: to recruit supporters
- {応援者|おうえんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声援|せいえん}→声援：10153_seien⟧: cheers from supporters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支持者|しじしゃ}→支持者：17852_shijisha⟧: supporter (more political; someone who endorses a position or candidate)
- ⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: fan (borrowed from English; focuses on admiration)
- ⟦サポーター→サポーター：10954_sapootaa⟧: supporter (loanword; often used in sports contexts)
- ⟦{応援団|おうえんだん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧: cheering squad (organized group, not an individual)
